rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Multi-cloud management server built by code-alchemist01 that provides unified access to AWS, Azure, and GCP resources through a single interface. Features cloud-agnostic adapters for each provider, comprehensive resource management tools for instances, storage, databases, and functions, plus specialized capabilities for cost analysis, monitoring, security scanning, and compliance checking. Built with TypeScript and official cloud SDKs, it handles credential management through environment variables, supports cross-cloud resource operations like starting and stopping instances, and includes formatters for consistent output across providers. Useful for DevOps teams managing multi-cloud infrastructure, cost optimization workflows, security auditing across cloud environments, and workflows requiring unified visibility and control across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
